groups.note: County, municipal, school, and special-district names are keyed from official Converse clerk general summaries (2020, 2022, 2024, and 2026), the official 2018 general EL45 (Clerk of District Court), and the official 2016 scanned general summary (2016 commissioners). Official 2014 and parts of official 2016 and 2018 local canvasses are archived but were not fully keyed here, so January 2015–2019 local rows are largely Not yet collected rather than invented. Multi-county legislative seats use official SOS district-wide Total rows, with the official Converse share noted. Official 2014 and 2018 SOS show a Senate District 23 Converse sliver; official 2022 and 2026 SOS Converse rows for S23 are blank after redistricting. Official 2014–2020 SOS show House District 3 and House District 4 Converse slivers; official 2022+ Converse rows for those districts are blank, and House District 62 (Converse and Natrona) begins with the official 2022 SOS. Douglas, Glenrock, Rolling Hills, and Lost Springs mayors are elected on the official November ballot, not chosen by the council. Official mid-term: approved April 10, 2026 commission minutes appoint Barbara Harris Clerk of District Court from April 10, 2026, through January 4, 2027, after Pam McCullough vacated the office; official 2026 clerk results elect Harris beginning January 4, 2027. Official 2026 CCSD #1 fourth-place finisher Adam Camino is the official itemized write-in (medium confidence). Official write-in-only contests without a named certified winner (including official 2022 and 2024 Lost Springs council, official 2022 Lost Springs mayor, official 2024 and 2026 some hospital and cemetery 2-year seats, and official 2026 Lost Springs 2-year council write-in totals 0) are left unfilled. Official DocumentCenter 4724 is the official 2022 primary commissioners recount, not a general-election change.

sources.label: Official Converse County 2020 general election summary (DocumentCenter 3289; header OFFICIAL RESULTS, 11/05/2020 10:16 AM)
Official Converse County 2024 general election summary (DocumentCenter 5775; header OFFICIAL RESULTS, 11/07/2024 02:35PM)

groups.note: Supreme Court justices and the Chancery Court judge are the people in office this January, from official Wyoming Judicial Branch dates and official retention results (shared with other counties). Official 2026 Converse clerk RETAIN JUDGE BEN BURNINGHAM is that statewide Chancery retention, not a local 8th JD seat. Local rows are 8th Judicial District judges (Converse, Goshen, Niobrara, and Platte). Full names are taken from official Wyoming Judicial Branch 8th JD Converse District Court, Converse (Douglas) Circuit Court, and Goshen (Torrington) Circuit Court pages, plus official Converse clerk retention lines, and those sources are cited. Judges of other districts are not copied here.
